text.card: A red giant 5,609 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.99 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,025 K at its surface.
